analysis: Bounded ordinary LLVM disassembly, corroborated by historical ERM2Object navigation source. No original Windows execution, binary upload or new Hopper result.

observations.fact: ERM2Object stores the visiting hero pointer as source current hero and derives the coordinate context from the visited position.
For a non-hero object, ProcessERM is called for the object type, then type/subtype, then packed coordinates, in separate priority groups.
A distinct encountered hero selects setup hero number+30100 rather than the coordinate object trigger. The visiting hero pointer remains the current hero.

implementation: Preserve priority supplied to dispatchAny, preserve source file order within each group, deduplicate repeated group selectors and serialize the ordered continuation unchanged.
Pass type, type/subtype, coordinates in original order for physical objects and synthetic source plot tiles.
Distinct hero contacts dispatch HE for the encountered hero type; HE-1 remains the visitor. Scripted HO native restrictions still gate exchange or combat after completion.
limitations: Self-hero underlay reconstruction, the complete post-event lifecycle and remaining original receivers are not validated by this lot.
The private native meeting and trigger controls do not establish complete original quests, battles, victories or campaign transfers. Original campaigns remain disabled.
